Scientific/media identities use original helper-window seals and stat only; ordinary delta SHA, normal main push and separate-directory ff-only restore are used.

limits: No actual run conclusion: the authorized production session was still running and was not inspected or controlled by this review.

Static review is not a runtime test or a universal dynamic mechanical/file-open hook.
